calls.title: GrowthBook Demo for Kerala Ayurveda
calls.summary: Jake Heier (GrowthBook account manager) demoed the platform to Valentina Tarun Bhowal (product) and Kal Singhal (analytics) from Kerala Ayurveda. They discussed replacing their current pre-post analysis with GrowthBook’s feature flags and A/B testing, integrating with GA4 and BigQuery, and supporting staggered rollouts and multivariate experiments. Next steps: Jake will send documentation on pricing, CDN requests, value types, and Shopify integration; the Kerala Ayurveda team will review internally and follow up with questions.
